def flow_svg(uid, title, nodes, transitions, caption):
    # Standardize transition labels and box constraints to prevent node/icon/border collisions (R4)
    short_transitions = []
    for t in transitions:
        t_clean = t.replace('ClientHello status_request', 'status_request').replace('Staple CertificateStatus', 'Staple Status')
        t_clean = t_clean.replace('Transmit 1500B (DF=1)', 'Send 1500B DF=1').replace('ICMP Type 3 Code 4', 'ICMP Type 3/4')
        t_clean = t_clean.replace('Traverse internet', 'To Internet').replace('DNAT state lookup', 'DNAT lookup')
        t_clean = t_clean.replace('BGP UPDATE (AS 65001)', 'BGP UPDATE').replace('LPM packet egress', 'LPM egress')
        t_clean = t_clean.replace('CertVerify + Finished', 'Verify & Finish').replace('Verify Issuer Sig', 'Verify Sig')
        short_transitions.append(t_clean)
    svg = _flow_svg(uid, title, nodes, short_transitions, caption)
    svg = svg.replace('Identity & SAN Match', 'Identity & SAN')
    return svg.replace('../assets/icons/generic/../gcp/', '../assets/icons/gcp/')
